items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, there's some of the Billary is back there and then Claver. He didn't play there.

ctx.x: I can't remember that street so well. That's been a long time, 40, 40 times. He lived down below Dumain, the street next to Dumain Street. Yeah, they would call the name of it. What up? This is Humain and then there's St. Philip. He lived down on St. Philip and Murray, rather than that. And Robinson or Murray. Yeah. Not Robinson. Yeah. Philip, yeah.
Well, there's some of the Billary is back there and then Claver. He didn't play there.
Yeah. Well, Billary, he didn't live on Billary. He lived right next street to Dumain Street. Not just like Dumain. Yeah, probably St. Philip. Yeah. Right in that section.
